facebook_post.label: Facebook post: 1 premium image with the person; content type statement, stat, checklist or news (rotates between packages)

facebook_ad.label: Facebook ad: 3 variants of one ad with the person (headline, subheadline, CTA button)

linkedin_post.label: LinkedIn post: 1 square image (1:1) with the person by default; content type statement, stat, checklist or news

instagram_carousel.label: Instagram carousel: 6-8 slides (default 7), one story: hook, problem, steps or insights, example or result, call to action

reel_short.label: Short vertical video (reel), up to 90 s

ugc_ad.label: UGC-style video ad, up to 60 s

podcast_clip.label: Podcast clip: the person's own HeyGen avatar speaks the script, with optional b-roll, up to 90 s
